title: VB-Audio VB-CABLE virtual audio device kernel streaming driver (vbaudio_cable64_win10.sys 10.0.10011.16384) contains…
description: The VB-Audio VB-CABLE virtual audio device kernel streaming driver (vbaudio_cable64_win10.sys 10.0.10011.16384) has out-of-bounds read and write vulnerabilities in certain property handlers. These flaws allow a local standard user to exploit improper bounds checking when supplying an all-channels sentinel value, leading to potential kernel memory corruption or information disclosure. This can result in local privilege escalation or denial of service due to a kernel bug check.
